{{Top|leg}}
'''Redgill Pass''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was located between two [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] and led to [[Redgill Lake]]. It was a choke point for northward passage and because it was one of only two passes, it made defending Redgill [[Lake]] easier.
